title: TrackRead
detail: Role: Frontend lead. Challenge: dense data had to stay scannable in a retro theme. Solution: inventory-style metric cards + minimal charts. Result: loads in <1.2s, demo used by 3 indie studios.

title: InternalDesk
detail: Role: Fullstack. Challenge: cart & promos had to stay clear without a swipe trap. Solution: horizontal carousel + sticky #ff6b6b CTA. Result: +18% CTR to checkout.

title: TriAgent
tagline: Three AI agents on one shared, provider-agnostic core.
detail: Role: Solo build. Challenge: keep AI decisions auditable and safe across three very different tasks. Solution: one shared LLM core with provider failover, deterministic guardrails in code, and a single React UI for Mail (email agent), Lens (scrape & summarize) and Docs (grounded document chat). Result: runs fully offline on a mock LLM and switches to DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with one key.
